verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a mobile SSH/Mosh terminal with VS Code/Codespaces connectivity, so an AI agent that reviews pull requests is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence shows no built-in AI agent, PR analysis, or code-suggestion capability. Running an agent on a remote server over SSH, or inside Codespaces, would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.
